name: OpenMayhem API
description: Pay-per-use AI inference over a decentralised provider network. OpenAI-compatible where an equivalent exists. Billing is reserve-then-settle from prepaid credit; every charge settles against a provider-signed receipt. Human docs: https://openmayhem.ai/docs (each page also at /docs/<slug>.md).
